display_long_description:
Welcome to MECH LEAGUE Boxing—an adrenaline-pumping, metal-punching VR boxing experience. Step into your mech and rise through the ranks using using powerful punches, well-timed dodges, and precise counters

Feel every hit. Break a sweat. Earn your way to the top.

In a future where mech battles are the ultimate escape, robot fighting has become the arena where champions are made. Now it’s your turn.

MECH LEAGUE Boxing is a full-body VR game and workout where every punch, dodge, and counter is powered by real movement. No buttons—just pure VR combat.

FEATURES

Full-body VR combat
Punch, block, and dodge in real time.

VR workout
Burn calories and build stamina while you fight.

Fast-paced action
Test your reflexes in intense VR fighting.

Intergalactic arenas
Battle across unique locations.

Train and improve
Sharpen your skills and rise through the ranks.

Weapons & mech combat
Grab, smash, and dominate your opponents.

Customize your mech
Upgrade gloves, helmets, and gear.
